words.definition: used to ask about the number of something
words.example: How many students are in the classroom?

words.definition: used to ask for information about something
words.example: What do you do?

words.definition: used to ask about the type of something
words.example: What kind of music do you like?

words.definition: used to ask about time
words.example: When do you go to the gym?

words.definition: used to ask about a place or position
words.example: Where does he live?

words.definition: used to ask about a choice between things
words.example: Which class are you in?

words.definition: used to ask about a person
words.example: Who are you?

words.definition: used to ask for a reason
words.example: Why are you so tired?

words.definition: used to ask if someone wants something more
words.example: Anything else? ~ Yes, a mineral water, please.
words.example_ru: Что-нибудь еще? ~ Да, минеральную воду, пожалуйста.

words.word: Can I have an espresso, please?
words.definition: a polite way to order in a café
words.example: Can I have an espresso, please?

words.definition: used by a shop assistant to offer help
words.example: Can I help you? ~ A black coffee, please.
words.example_ru: Я могу вам помочь? ~ Черный кофе, пожалуйста.

words.definition: used to ask the price of something
words.example: How much is that? ~ That's £12.45, please.

words.word: To have here or take away?
words.definition: a question asked in a café
words.example: To have here or take away? ~ To take away.
words.example_ru: Здесь или с собой? ~ С собой.

words.translation: Вот мы и на месте. Вот и мы.
words.definition: used when you arrive at a place
words.example: Here we are. Let's get out of the car and look around.
words.example_ru: Вот мы и на месте. Давай выйдем из машины и осмотримся.

words.definition: used to ask if someone is somewhere for the first time
words.example: Is this your first time in Oxford?
words.example_ru: Это твой первый раз в Оксфорде?

words.definition: used when you meet someone for the first time
words.example: Hi! I'm Rob. ~ Nice to meet you, Rob.
words.example_ru: Привет! Я Роб. ~ Приятно познакомиться, Роб.

words.definition: used when saying goodbye to someone you will speak to again
words.example: I'll see you in the afternoon. Talk to you later.

words.definition: every person
words.example: Everybody here uses English File.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: all things
words.example: Everything here is very nice.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: used to show interest in something
words.example: I'm a singer. ~ Really? How interesting! Are you in a band?
words.example_ru: Я певица. ~ Правда? Как интересно! Ты в группе?
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: used to add another thing you like
words.example: I also like the food here.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: used to say you like something very much
words.example: I really love going on holiday.
words.example_ru: Я действительно люблю ездить в отпуск.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: used to say you agree or have the same experience
words.example: I like listening to music. ~ Me too.
words.example_ru: Я люблю слушать музыку. ~ Я тоже.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: the thing you like best
words.example: My favourite thing about this country is the people.
words.example_ru: Мое любимое в этой стране — это люди.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: used to show surprise or interest
words.example: I'm a singer. ~ Really? How interesting.
words.topic: More words and phrases in File 3

words.definition: the sister of your mother or father
words.example: My mum's sister, my aunt, is two years older than she is.
words.example_ru: Сестра моей мамы, моя тетя, на два года старше ее.

words.definition: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
words.example: That's my brother and his son.
words.example_ru: Это мой брат и его сын.

words.definition: the brother of your husband or wife, or the husband of your sister
words.example: My brother-in-law still lives with his parents.
words.example_ru: Мой зять все еще живет со своими родителями.

words.definition: plural of child
words.example: He has three children, two boys and a girl.
words.example_ru: У него трое детей: два мальчика и девочка.

words.definition: the child of your aunt or uncle
words.example: My cousin goes to the same school as me.
words.example_ru: Мой двоюродный брат ходит в ту же школу, что и я.

words.definition: a person's female child
words.example: My daughter is four years old.

words.definition: a male parent
words.example: My father is a doctor.

words.definition: the father of your mother or father
words.example: My grandfather is 78 years old.
